_doc: Verbatim role-guard refusals from the first real v2 trial (lcsmas/vf2-trial ledger #4; transcripts ~/.claude-vf2/projects/*/*.jsonl): Bash tool_use inputs whose tool_result starts 'PreToolUse:Bash hook error' and carries 'BLOCKED (role:'. `cases` = FALSE POSITIVES (expected allow after #475; deny on the pre-#475 guard). Each has must-DENY `siblings` (same shape; a prepended/replaced span makes the target a real repo path or an unresolvable variable). `byDesign` = check chained with force-push, denied BY DESIGN (control, not a false positive). cwd = the transcript entry's cwd (else the previous entry's); tmpdir = the scratch dir named in the deny text (= the hook env TMPDIR).

cases.command: sed -i 's/Dispdispositions/Dispositions/' "$TMPDIR/ops/c3.md" && gh api -X PATCH repos/lcsmas/vf2-trial/issues/comments/7025018825 -F body=@"$TMPDIR/ops/c3.md" -q .html_url 2>&1 | tail -1; git fetch origin -q; git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -c1-40
